description: MainActivity class for an Android Wear app implementing delayed confirmation, GoogleApiClient integration, and wearable communication.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android Activity managing wearable delayed confirmation, messaging, and capability handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up GoogleApiClient and UI components.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes capability listener and disconnects GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onTimerSelected
methods.description: Handles timer selection, sends message, shows notification.

methods.name: onTimerFinished
methods.description: Handles timer finish, sends message, shows notification.

methods.name: sendMessageToCompanion
methods.description: Sends message to paired device via Wearable API.

methods.name: getSendMessageResultCallback
methods.description: Callback for message send result, logs success or failure.

methods.name: setupConfirmationHandlerNode
methods.description: Sets up capability listener and retrieves capability info.

methods.name: updateConfirmationCapability
methods.description: Updates the node capable of handling confirmation.

methods.name: pickBestNode
methods.description: Selects the best node based on proximity.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient connects, initiates capability setup.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Updates node info when capability changes.
